title: Psalms 12
paragraphs: ¹ Help, LORD, for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished from the human race. ² Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts. ³ May the LORD silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue — ⁴ those who say, "We will triumph with our tongues; we own our lips — who is our master?" ⁵ "Because the poor are plundered, because the needy groan, I will now arise," says the LORD; "I will protect them from those who malign them."

⁶ The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times. ⁷ You, LORD, will keep the needy safe and will protect them forever from this corrupt generation, ⁸ even though the wicked strut about and evil is praised throughout the land.
